messages:
Sam (Sales): handoff for Harlequin trial — 30d pilot starts today. Customer asks: SAML SSO, VPC peering (peer CIDR 10.60.0.0/16), and reserved throughput for scheduled spike tests (~420 rps). Billing contact: billing@harlequin.ai.
Asha (CS): added to Gainsight, set playbook for 30/45/55d touches. We should track API error rate, median & 95p latency, and weekly active users.
Diego (Support): Ill open a ticket and tag infra. Can someone paste the SAML metadata and cert thumbprint? Also confirm whether egress should be strictly allowlisted.
Sam (Sales): SAML metadata sent via secure email to Asha. No custom weights; customer expects parity with hosted. They provided 2 system prompts to seed behavior. Egress = allowlist to our regions + customer monitoring endpoints.
provision-bot: Ticket CS-6029 created by Diego: "Harlequin pilot — SAML + VPC peering + reserved throughput". Assignees: @rina_eng, @asha_cs. ETA for peering validation: 36h.
Rina (Eng): taking eng tasks. Action items: 1) validate VPC peering and run connectivity smoke tests, 2) stage SAML on test IdP and validate assertions, 3) allocate reserved slot and run quick sanity generate on quantized-v2. Will post smoke test command and results.
Diego (Support): added network checklist and log template to CS-6029. Please attach sample traces if you see any >500ms; set priority high.
Clara (Success Manager): Ill prepare a short week-1 feedback survey and feed responses into the health dashboard. Initial renewal risk: medium (dependent on pilot perf and network ease).
Asha (CS): owners recap: Rina — eng tasks; Diego — support ticket & logs; Clara — success metrics & survey; Sam — customer comms. Next steps: Rina confirm peering CIDRs + smoke test output; Diego post ticket updates; Sam schedule week-1 demo. If peering blocks, tag #eng-oncall for escalation. :thumbsup:
